## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [續法](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BA%8C%E6%B3%95) Xùfǎ is a doctrinal-devotional treatise on the *Avataṃsaka*'s teaching of the *fǎ jiè zōng* 法界宗 ("Dharma-Realm Lineage" — i.e. the Huáyán school) cast in the metaphor of the *lián huā* 蓮花 (lotus flower), an iconic Buddhist devotional image.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1660 – 1715) reflects [續法](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BA%8C%E6%B3%95) Xùfǎ's mature scholarly activity. The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1027) collection.
